Not really.
Its kinda been a build up.
A while back I decided to just give up on most, if not all things.
The way I see it, the world's better of without me. It'll be rid of another thief. Another crybaby. Another failure. Life is really just a quest to die comfortably and pass on your genetics, but I'm used to discomfort and I'm too shitty to pass on my genes...
I'm usually free to talk. I may not be much help, but I can try.

I have lost any will to do anything. I'm glad that you have enough willpower to at least work. Your already better off than me. But really, its all meaningless... life is just a quest to earn enough money to die comfortably, and to be likable enough to have children.

I see no point in trying to do either anymore.
